name: subscription_started
description: The first paid charge of a subscription succeeded.
trigger: The provider webhook confirms the first successful charge. Sent from the server.
nonTriggers: Not on a trial starting — a trial is not a subscription.

properties.name: plan_id
properties.description: The plan, as the payment provider knows it.

properties.name: billing_period
properties.description: How often the plan is charged.

properties.name: amount_minor
properties.description: The charge in the currency's minor unit (cents). An integer, never a float.

properties.name: is_trial_conversion
properties.description: Whether a trial converted into this subscription.
